title: 放水始め
mood: sweaty, heroic and a little ridiculous
subject: a bicycle-shop owner in his town's volunteer fire brigade, drilling every July night behind the community hall under a captain with a stopwatch for the prefectural fire-pump drill competition, where a twisted hose costs them points and they finish ninth
caption: Japanese arena hard rock, the blues-based stadium style with riff-driven verses and a gang-vocal sing-along chorus. A Les Paul through a cranked Marshall stack playing a chugging palm-muted riff with pinch harmonics, then a fast, melodic wah-pedal solo; a second rhythm guitar double-tracking the riff, panned opposite; a punchy picked electric bass locked to the kick; live drums with double-kick fills and crash-heavy choruses; a Hammond organ swelling under the chorus. Loud, tight arena-rock production, stacked guitars, roomy drums. Male high tenor lead with a raspy, powerful belt and clipped, rhythmic phrasing, gang shouts answering the chorus calls. 146 BPM, E minor. Sweaty, heroic and a little ridiculous. No synth pads, no EDM drops, no autotune, no screamed metal vocals, no pop-punk, no anime-theme J-pop gloss.
lyrics:
[Intro - overdriven guitar riff, crash cymbals and a four-stick drum count-in]

[Verse 1]
七月の夜 公民館の裏
投光器の下 汗と蚊取り線香
昼間は自転車屋 油まみれの手で
銀の筒先を 握りしめる

[Pre-Chorus]
分団長が ストップウォッチ押して
「遅い もう一本」 これで十本目

[Chorus - lead vocal, gang shouts answer]
「放水始め!」 腹から叫べ
筒先構えて 腰を落とせ
的が倒れりゃ それでいい
誰も見てない 夜の練習でも

[Verse 2]
大会の朝 県の運動公園
アイロンかけた 活動服
敬礼の角度 膝の角度
審査員の 鉛筆が走る

[Chorus - lead vocal, gang shouts answer]
「放水始め!」 腹から叫べ
筒先構えて 腰を落とせ
的が倒れた その瞬間
四十八秒 自己ベスト

[Instrumental Break - fast wah-pedal guitar solo over the riff]

[Bridge - half-time, bass and drums under the vocal]
分団長は 「もう一本」と 言わずに
ストップウォッチを 胸ポケットに しまった

[Chorus - full band, gang shouts]
「放水始め!」 腹から叫べ
ホースのねじれで 減点くらって
それでも九位だ 胸を張れ
来年の夏も 公民館の裏

[Outro - riff, big drum fill and a final held chord]
